description: Local trigger and behavior evals for the git-and-ci model_decision rule.

trigger_cases.prompt: Commit these verified changes cleanly across our refactor phases and push them to origin/master.
Update the Ruff lint configuration and GitHub pre-submit workflow, then rebase and push to master.
How many epochs did ITGPT train in configs/ddc/itgpt_placement_fraxtil_orig_128ep.json?

behavior_cases.prompt: We just completed and verified Phase 1 of an approved 3-phase refactor in StepCOVNet. Should we keep Phase 1 uncommitted/local until Phase 3 is done, or what should we do next before starting Phase 2?
rubric: Explicitly states that Phase 1 must be verified, committed, and pushed to the remote before starting Phase 2 rather than holding commits locally.
